title: Each raised notification's record is read through the door
requirement: the record each raised notification leaves is readable through the door, as part of the engine's own state: one record per raise, read-only and bounded like every other answer of the door
observed_gap: `System notification on a change of state` says each raise "leaves a record a check reads" and does not say through what; no entry says the door offers that record, while the external harness's check of Theme 5 reads the status line, the report and that record through the door (Conductor `v4-12`).
acceptance: After the engine has raised notifications, a reader that has only the door obtains exactly one record for each notification raised; each record tells which change of state it was raised for and when; the answer changes nothing and is bounded in size and time like every other answer of the door.
